title: Early healing after regenerative periodontal surgery with or without antibiotics. Dolińska, Ewa & Pietruska, Małgorzata & Milewski, Robert & Sculean, Anton
authors: (2025). Early healing after regenerative periodontal surgery with or without antibiotics. Dental and Medical Problems. 601-608. 10.17219/dmp/175893.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The administration of systemic amoxicillin after regenerative periodontal surgery did not have any effect on early wound healing; however, it yielded a statistically significant CAL gain after 6 months compared to the group treated without antibiotics” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
